sloka: सुरासुरैरवध्यत्वं दत्तमस्मै स्वयम्भुवा।एतच्च कवचं दिव्यं रथश्चैषो ऽर्कभास्वरः ।। ६.७१.३२ ।।
transliteration: surāsurairavadhyatvaṁ dattamasmai svayambhuvā।etacca kavacaṁ divyaṁ rathaścaiṣo 'rkabhāsvaraḥ ।। 6.71.32 ।।

translations.english: "Exemption from death from gods and demons was given to him and all this wonderful shield and chariot as bright as the sun."
